note: Both sets cover essentially the same member sizes and dimensions from the detail callouts, with the same vague 'component' claims and the same duplicated plate/angle/beam entries. Set A adds a claim for W10X12 with the condition 'Structure South Elevation - Main', which appears nowhere on this page and is therefore invented. Set B instead lists W10X12 as a plain structural member section, which is supported by the text layer. That single unsupported condition makes A less faithful; everything else is equivalent.
remarks: Both sets repeat the same facts under two names (Plate (PL) vs PL member for 5X3/8 and 4 1/2X4 1/2X1/2; W-beam vs structural member for W8X10), and both use vague entities like 'component' for bare dimensions (6", 4", 1/4" TYP) whose owning detail is not resolvable from the text layer alone. The claim 'C3X6 | quantity | 1' is weakly supported in both sets — the '1' in the text layer is a detail callout number, not clearly a member count. Many important facts on the page (e.g., L4X4X5/16, W10X15, 11 1/2", 1 13/16", 5 7/8", 1'-3") are captured only partially or not at all by either set.
